title: Enrolment sends nothing; its rows go straight to the worklist
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. A customer whose setting "Maintenance notifications" is on and who has a contact with an email address.
  3. A schedule with PM-A (calendar Every 30 days) exists.
  4. Give the test customer's contact an email address you can open (e.g. your own work email), so the reminder lands in your inbox.
custom_steps:
1. Enrol one of the customer's assets on the schedule with PM-A's last service date 40 days before today, and read the confirmation shown after Enroll.
  2. Open Customers > Maintenance reminders and find the asset's PM-A row.
  3. Open the row's Contact card and read the line under the email address.
  4. Look in your inbox (the contact's address) for any reminder email.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The confirmation states both halves: the rows appear on the worklist, and no email is sent for them.
  • The PM-A row is listed at once with its real status "Overdue" (40 days since the last service on a 30-day interval).
  • The card shows that no reminder has been sent (no last sent date).
  • No reminder email has arrived in your inbox.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10564 (S7, Enrol an asset onto a schedule), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S7 (What enrolling sends, and what it does not; S7-R9, S7-R10, S7-N2); Plan 1 — Track, act, clear — Technical Implementation Plan, section 6 Phase P2, sketch (EnrolmentDialog caption); Design board "Chunk 1.dc.html" (MR V2 Claude Design project, version of 6 October 2026), artboard X1s; read 6 Oct 2026.
